name: open_how
synopsis: struct open_how { u64 flags; /* O_* flags */ u64 mode; /* Mode for O_{CREAT,TMPFILE} */ u64 resolve; /* RESOLVE_* flags */ /* ... */ };
description: Defines a structure that specifies how a pathname should be opened. It includes fields for flags, mode, and resolve options to control file opening behavior.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the file creation and file status flags to use when opening the file.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Specifies the mode for the new file.

parameters.name: resolve
parameters.description: A bit mask of flags that modify the way in which all components of a pathname will be resolved.

bugs: Users must zero-fill the structure on initialization to ensure compatibility with potential extra fields added in future versions.
